node_definition.done_when:
Evaluate the options for the converged forward solve against the lead's target, and recommend one with measurements. The lead asked: "have we taken the wrong approach for these cut cells, we need fixed point convergence in <1ms. Evaluate our other options".

Where the solve stands. The forward solve iterates cell current moments m = book(read(psi_ext + G m)). read is the locked fixed points (nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py, p99 under 0.9 ms) plus the Bell-only level-set membership; book is nova/equilibrium/current.py, exact polygon booking of cut cells, 26 ms at 2,098 cells and 85 ms at 5,158 on the H200. The held moment-space Newton (worktree /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/nova-a0f1e0938fc2/s21-nova/moment-space-newton, unmerged; read only; its code is on PYTHONPATH from there) converges analytic states in 2 to 3 steps to 1e-12. Each solve still takes 7 to 42 minutes, because jax.jacfwd builds the dense Jacobian (6,294 columns at 2,000 cells; 140 to 170 s per step; LU 0.03 s). Its receipts are under /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261013T185617649894-moment-space-newton/validated-booking-20261014T005433Z and /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261013T185617649894-moment-space-newton/terminal-review. Both production seeds give NaN at step 0 (saddle and axis WRONG_ROOT). Finite differences from 1e-3 to 1e-7 are NaN and disagree by 26 percent at 1e-8 on the diverted state. Earlier device Krylov took 21 to 27 minutes per solve over 13 to 17 steps.

Target as the coordinator reads it: a converged forward solve in under 1 ms on the H200 at 2,000 to 10,000 cells, warm-started from a neighbouring time slice. Report cold solves separately. State what per-iteration budget that implies.

Done when one research document, docs/research/forward-solve-options.html (reckon-type research, plan-informs converged-forward-solve), compares these options with numbers measured by prototypes under scripts/prototypes/solve_options. Measure each at 2,000, 5,000 and 10,000 cells on the analytic limited and diverted certificates, in one H200 job (rows inside the allocation, never an array):
(a) Exact cut-cell booking with a structured Jacobian, J = I - (dB/dpsi) G. The local part of dB/dpsi comes from colored JVPs over the stencil graph; the global terms (axis flux, X-point flux, current normalisation) come from the fixed points' implicit tangents. Then LU.
(b) Current carried at fixed quadrature nodes (centroids or a few Gauss points per cell) with a hard membership mask, as in grid-point real-time equilibrium codes.
(c) A smoothed membership of width about one pitch, so booking needs no polygon clipping. Measure its bias against exact.
(d) A frozen-support chord or relaxed Picard iteration that holds the cut geometry across inner iterations and refreshes it only when membership changes.
(e) Warm tracking: one or two Newton steps per slice on a cached factorisation from the previous slice.
(f) Whatever the literature shows reaching sub-millisecond on GPU (for example LIUQE, GPU EFIT variants, FreeGSNKE), and what accuracy each gives up to get there.
For each option report:
- per-iteration wall and iterations to its floor;
- total warm and cold wall;
- flux error against the analytic solution and its convergence order across the three rungs;
- whether JVPs match finite differences;
- whether the two production seeds converge;
- device memory;
- what code it adds and what it deletes.
End with a recommendation and the trade it makes. If no option reaches 1 ms, say so with the nearest measured one and what dominates its wall.
Profile the current chain once (read, membership, booking, G m, Jacobian) at the three rungs, so the evaluation starts from measured stage costs.

The figures go under docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/solve-options. Make one wall-against-cells plot per option on one canvas, and one plot of flux error against cells. Every poloidal panel follows AGENTS.md plotting rules. reckon audit-doc must report 0 errors.

This is a measurement and design node. Do not change nova/ product code. Do not merge or modify the held Newton worktree. The certified 550, 2,000 and 5,000-cell machines and exteriors are under /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261009T181553786165-proto-support/ordered/rows/cache, and the carrier-requalify ones (repaired kernel) are under /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261013T160532295843-carrier-requalify/rows/cache. The diverted 10,000-cell device carrier is under /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261014T011052155734-stencil-ten-thousand/carrier-resubmitted. Read these in place; never write them.

Run conditions: H200 rows run as one job through RECKON_ALLOW_NESTED_LAUNCH=1 scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh --log (an absolute path in the run directory) --wait -- (targets), or one sbatch job on --partition=betelgeuse --reservation=gpu_0003_grpA --gres=gpu:1 with rungs as rows inside the allocation (never an array), --time sized to finish, XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false and TMPDIR=/tmp in the submit environment and in every child; submit for real and read squeue a minute later rather than trusting sbatch --test-only. On a compute node run /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/.venv/bin/python directly with PYTHONPATH set to the run worktree and never invoke uv; every login-node uv command carries --no-sync and nothing runs uv sync. configure_dtypes() before any array and jax_enable_x64 asserted True. Gates pass by delta against orientation_base_sha in per-module fresh processes, both arms running the same test files with the repository root conftest, baseline_suite and after_suite as single-line JSON whose log_path names one log file and whose command is literally runnable. Any wait is declared on the job that finishes last as wait_probe ["sacct","-n","-X","-P","-j","(job id)","-o","State"] and wait_terminal ["COMPLETED","FAILED","CANCELLED","TIMEOUT","OUT_OF_MEMORY","NODE_FAIL"] as JSON lists, and names every job it depends on in wait_condition. The certified 550, 2,000 and 5,000-cell machines and exteriors are cached under /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261009T181553786165-proto-support/ordered/rows/cache and may be read in place, never written. Run filepath relativize over any evidence fragment before committing. Commit with conventional subjects and bodies at every step and write the manifest and commit before every job wait; the manifest commits line lists every commit; status is complete, blocked or failed, which the worker sets itself. No plan labels in source names or comments.

Import provenance: print nova.__file__ in every log header. On the fleet allocation (SLURM_JOB_ID set), run CPU work in place. The manifest commits line lists every commit, orientation_base_sha is copied from git rev-parse output, and status is complete, blocked or failed.
